# Horsewood (horsewood.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Horsewood, a herbal dietary supplement capsule for adult men (60 capsules per bottle) offered to support energy, stamina and everyday vitality.

## Key facts
- Printed ingredients per 2 capsules: Saw Palmetto Berry Extract 20 mg, Wild Yam Root Extract 20 mg, Sarsaparilla Root Extract 20 mg, Nettle Leaf Extract 20 mg, Boron Amino Acid Chelate 20 mg, Tongkat Ali 10 mg (100:1 extract), Horny Goat Weed 8 mg (10:1 extract)
- Directions: two capsules daily with an 8 oz glass of water; the capsule contains gelatin
- Packs (USD): 1 bottle $89; 3 bottles $59 each ($177 plus shipping); 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping)
- One-time purchase; 60-day money-back guarantee, subject to the terms shown at checkout
- Not a treatment for any condition; adult men only; ask a doctor first if taking prescription medicine, especially heart, blood pressure, blood-thinning, diabetes or hormone-related medicine
